issues.summary: Verifier claimed `net10.0` TFM is invalid; proposed `net10`.
issues.resolution: Orchestrator dismissal accepted by human (option b). .NET TFMs include the major.minor (net6.0/net7.0/net8.0/net9.0/net10.0). The build succeeds with net10.0 and the existing 1.0.0 release shipped with the same TFM. Adjudication recorded via record_adjudication.
Removed `FormatWithExplicitOffset`; the single call site now uses `ExpectedFormatted`. Tests still pass (601 / 601).
